Language

LLaMA examines efficient foundation models

A family of language models emphasized training efficiency and publicly available training data.

Hugo Touvron and colleagues

AI topics

Explore related entries. Larger tags appear on more entries.

Language modelsTransformersEfficient modelsScaling

The contribution

The original LLaMA paper introduced models spanning 7 to 65 billion parameters and examined how training choices affected performance. It showed that smaller models trained extensively could be competitive on the reported benchmarks.

What this does not establish

The original release had restricted research access. The word “open” in the title does not establish an unrestricted open-source license or full reproducibility.

Why this date?

The first arXiv submission was 27 February 2023.

This entry follows the linked publication. Read the source and date conventions.
